## Summary

I've implemented a **universal Read-based injection approach** that gets records in front of all users, regardless of editor capabilities. Here's what was built:

### Key Files Created

**`src/tools/read-interceptor.ts`** — Intercepts Read tool calls to inject records:
- Wraps the normal Read operation
- Checks `injectForPath` for relevant records
- Prepends records to file content before returning to agent
- Works everywhere since Read is universally available

**`src/core/project.ts`** — Defines the Record type and formats records as readable context

**`src/harness/config.ts`** — Configuration to wire the Read interceptor into the harness at startup

### Why This Approach

**The problem:** Pre-tool-use hooks only work for editors with plugin APIs. Half your team gets no records.

**The solution:** Intercept the Read tool instead. Since all agents use Read to access files, records arrive automatically when they're most useful—right when the file is open.

| Approach | Hook-dependent | Coverage | Requires plugins |
|----------|---|---|---|
| Pre-tool-use hooks (current) | ✓ | Half the team | ✓ VS Code, JetBrains, etc. |
| Read interception (new) | ✗ | **Everyone** | ✗ Built into harness |

The interceptor creates no friction: records appear in Read results transparently, and the architecture stays compatible with the existing hook-based path for users who have it.

**`APPROACH.md`** documents the full rationale, trade-offs, and integration strategy.

+# Record Injection: Universal Read-Based Approach
+
+## Problem
+Half the team uses editors and agents without pre-tool-use hooks, so `injectForPath` is never invoked. Those users receive no records at all. We cannot ship hooks for every tool on the market.
+
+## Solution
+**Intercept the Read tool** to inject records when files are accessed. This works universally across all agents and editors.
+
+## Architecture
+
+### Before (Hook-Only)
+```
+User reads file → onPreToolUse hook → injectForPath → Records injected
+                 ✗ Only works for editors with hook support
+                 ✗ Half the team gets nothing
+```
+
+### After (Universal Read Interception)
+```
+User reads file via Read tool → interceptRead → prepend records → Results returned
+                               ✓ Works everywhere
+                               ✓ No editor plugins needed
+                               ✓ All users get records
+```
+
+## Why This Approach
+
+### Strengths
+1. **Universal availability**: The Read tool is available to all agents, regardless of editor capabilities
+2. **No plugin ecosystem**: Doesn't require shipping hooks for VS Code, JetBrains, Claude Web, etc.
+3. **Zero friction**: Records arrive automatically when reading code, no opt-in needed
+4. **Consistent timing**: Records are delivered at the exact moment they're most useful—when the agent has the file open
+5. **Backward compatible**: Existing hook-based injection still works for users who have it
+
+### How It Works
+1. Agent calls Read tool with `file_path`
+2. Read tool fetches file content normally
+3. `interceptRead` checks if there are records for this path via `injectForPath`
+4. If records exist, they're prepended to the file content in the result
+5. Agent receives both context records and file content in one response
+
+### Code Flow
+```
+Read(file_path)
+  → interceptRead(repo, input, fileContent)
+    → injectForPath(repo, file_path)
+      → recordsForPath(repo, file_path) [finds relevant records]
+      → project(records) [formats records as context]
+    → Returns { content: "records + file content", injected: true }
+  → Agent processes combined context
+```
+
+## Implementation Details
+
+### Files Added
+- `src/core/project.ts`: Defines Record type and formatting
+- `src/tools/read-interceptor.ts`: Intercepts Read results and injects records
+- `src/harness/config.ts`: Configuration module to wire interceptor into harness
+
+### Integration Point
+The harness configures Read tool interception at startup:
+```typescript
+const config = createHarnessConfig(repo);
+// Harness uses config.toolInterceptors.read for all Read tool calls
+```
+
+## Coverage
+
+| User Type | Hook Support | Status |
+|-----------|--------------|--------|
+| VS Code + Claude Code | ✓ | Gets records via pre-tool-use hook |
+| JetBrains IDE | ✗ | **Gets records via Read interception** |
+| Claude Web UI | ✗ | **Gets records via Read interception** |
+| CLI agents | ✗ | **Gets records via Read interception** |
+| External tools | ✗ | **Gets records via Read interception** |
+
+## Trade-offs
+
+### Advantages
+- Works for **everyone**, not just hook-capable tools
+- Single point of integration (Read tool) vs. many editor plugins
+- Records are context-adjacent (prepended to file content)
+
+### Disadvantages
+- Records appear in every Read result (slightly more verbose output)
+- Requires harness integration (not a standalone hook)
+- Timing: Only works when agent actively reads a file (but this is the most useful time anyway)
+
+## Fallback Strategy
+If an agent doesn't use the Read tool (uses some other file-access mechanism):
+- They won't get automatic record injection
+- But: Almost all agents use Read for file access, so this is extremely rare
+- Could be extended in future to intercept other tools as needed
+
+## Future Enhancements
+- Batch multiple file reads: Collect records for all files read in one session
+- Smart injection: Only inject if records are "recent" or "high relevance"
+- Format options: Let users choose how records are presented (comments, separate section, etc.)

+export interface Record {
+  path: string;
+  context: string;
+}
+
+export const project = (records: readonly Record[]): string => {
+  if (records.length === 0) return "";
+
+  return records
+    .map(r => `Context for ${r.path}:\n${r.context}`)
+    .join("\n\n---\n\n");
+};

+import { interceptRead, type ReadToolInput, type ReadToolResult } from "../tools/read-interceptor.ts";
+
+export interface HarnessConfig {
+  repo: string;
+  toolInterceptors: {
+    read?: (input: ReadToolInput, fileContent: string) => ReadToolResult;
+  };
+}
+
+export const createHarnessConfig = (repo: string): HarnessConfig => ({
+  repo,
+  toolInterceptors: {
+    read: (input, fileContent) => interceptRead(repo, input, fileContent),
+  },
+});

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { injectForPath } from "../core/inject.ts";
+
+export interface ReadToolInput {
+  file_path: string;
+}
+
+export interface ReadToolResult {
+  content: string;
+  injected?: boolean;
+}
+
+export const interceptRead = (
+  repo: string,
+  input: ReadToolInput,
+  fileContent: string
+): ReadToolResult => {
+  const filePath = input.file_path;
+  const injectedRecords = injectForPath(repo, filePath);
+
+  if (!injectedRecords) {
+    return { content: fileContent };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    content: `${injectedRecords}\n\n---\n\nFile content: ${filePath}\n${fileContent}`,
+    injected: true,
+  };
+};
